summary: Design sources (Digital): the committed RTL under src/ and rtl/, the boot-ROM generator chain, the klt/Yosys synthesis request, and the two derived gate-level netlists of record (klt/Yosys: librelane-gds-signoff-check 20261010-205400-af36071; LibreLane post-route: gds run 38083802720 at bce5bf4), each listed with its sha256. Audited 2026-10-10 against main 5669077 for issue #83; refreshed for issue #139 (the 223-word UART-load boot ROM) and for issue #208 (DR 0015's P1 and P2), and here for the merged design of both (PR #212). Refreshed for issue #137 (the load-phase CRC readout on uo_out).
